column3: The inaugural draft was conducted on the ESPN app while most of us were living together. Most of the details of this draft have been lost to history.
The original plan was to draft on the ESPN app again, but a manager wasn't added to the league in time so it wouldn't let us draft online. We pivoted to a spreadsheet draft instead.
We drafted on the ESPN fantasy app. One manager slept through almost the entirety of the draft.
A draft we weren't sure was even going to happen due to COVID, but we ended up all meeting at an AirBnb in the desert.
A Phoenix/Scottsdale draft weekend curated by the 3rd place finisher. It began with welcome drinks and dinner Saturday night.
Location not yet finalized for next year's draft.
